name: Matšoenyeho
tagline: Ho feta ho tšoenyeha. Ho na le lisebelisoa tse thusang.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse
sources: National Department of Health Mental Health Directorate

what_is_it.heading: Matšoenyeho ka mantsoe a hlakileng
what_is_it.lede: Matšoenyeho ke seo u se utloang ha alamo ea 'mele oa hau e lla khafetsa, ka lentsoe le phahameng haholo, kapa ho se na kotsi ea sebele e teng. E mong le e mong o ikutloa a tšoenyehile ka linako tse ling. Lefu la ho tšoenyeha ke ha le kena tseleng ea bophelo bo tloaelehileng.
paragraphs: Ho na le mefuta e mengata: matšoenyeho a akaretsang (ho tšoenyeha kamehla), ho tšoha (maqhubu a tšohanyetso a tšabo e matla), matšoenyeho a sechaba (tšabo ea ho ahloloa), phobias tse itseng, PTSD kamora ho sithabela maikutlo. Lia kopana 'me li arolelana melao-motheo ea phekolo.

Matšoenyeho a na le karolo e matla ea 'mele - pelo e mathang, ho fufuleloa, ho hema ka thata, ho tsekela, ho nyekeloa ke pelo, ho thothomela. 'Mele o utloa eka o kotsing le ha kelello e tseba hore ha ho joalo. Sena ke 'nete, eseng 'tsohle tse hloohong ea hau'. E ea phekoleha.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.headline: E tloaelehileng haholo
items.body: Mathata a ho tšoenyeha ke sehlopha se atileng haholo sa maemo a bophelo bo botle ba kelello lefatšeng. Hoo e ka bang motho a le mong ho ba 5 ba Afrika Boroa o ba le phihlelo ka nako e itseng.

items.headline: E ka phekoleha
items.body: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), meriana, le liphetoho tsa mokhoa oa bophelo li sebetsa hantle ho batho ba bangata. Ha o a tlameha ho phela le yona.

items.headline: Le 'meleng
items.body: Matšoenyeho a utloahala 'meleng - ho otla ha pelo, ho hema, ho tsekela. Hangata batho ba nahana hore ba na le lefu la pelo. Ho e hlokomela ho ea thusa.

items.headline: Thuso ea mahala
items.body: SADAG le LifeLine li fana ka tlhabollo ea mahala ea matšoenyeho. Likliniki li fana ka tlhahlobo le kalafo mahala. Thuso e haufi ho feta kamoo o nahanang.

pull_quote.text: Ho tšoenyeha ha se pontšo ea bofokoli. Ke sesupo sa hore alamo ea hau e sebetsa nako e eketsehileng. Litaba tse monate: lisebelisoa tsa alamo li ka koetlisoa hape.

signs.heading: Matšoenyeho a shebahala joang
signs.lede: Matšoenyeho a bonahala ka litsela tse tharo tse ka sehloohong—’meleng, kelellong le boitšoarong. Mohlomong u hlokomela tse ling tsa tsona.

items.title: Mmeleng
items.description: Pelo e mathang, ho phefumoloha ka potlako kapa ho ikutloa u sa khone ho hema, ho fufuleloa, ho thothomela, ho nyekeloa ke pelo kapa ho ferekana ke mala, ho tsekela, sefuba se thata, ho thothomela, ho chesa kapa ho bata.

items.title: Kelellong
items.description: Matšoenyeho a sa khaotseng - esita le ka lintho tse nyane, tšabo, lebelo la kelello, ho lebella tse mpe, ho sitoa ho tsepamisa mohopolo, ho ts'oara menahano ea 'ho thoe'ng, bothata ba ho robala.

items.title: Boitšoarong
items.description: Ho qoba maemo a etsang hore o tshwenyehe, o hloka ho tiisetswa kamehla, ho hlahlojwa le ho hlahlojwa, ho teneha, ho ikhula bathong, ho sebedisa jwala kapa dintho tse itseng ho kokobetsa maikutlo.

myths.heading: Seo eleng nnete le seo eseng sona

items.myth: Matšoenyeho ke ho tšoenyeha haholo feela. Khaotsa ho nahana ho feta tekano.
items.fact: Mathata a ho tšoenyeha a ama liphetoho tsa 'nete bokong le 'meleng - eseng feela menahano. Ho bolella motho e mong hore 'feela u khaotse ho tšoenyeha' ho tšoana le ho bolella motho ea nang le lefu la tsoekere hore 'feela u laole tsoekere ea hao'. Ha e sebetse.

items.myth: Meriana ea ho tšoenyeha ea lemalla 'me e u fetola zombie.
items.fact: Meriana ea sejoale-joale e khahlanong le ho tšoenyeha (SSRIs haholo) ha e lemalle. E khutsisa tsamaiso ea alamo ka ho lekaneng hore phekolo le litsebo tsa ho sebetsana le boemo li ka sebetsa. Ha e fetole seo o leng sona.

items.myth: Ha o sa e bone, ha se nnete.
items.fact: Matšoenyeho ke boemo ba bongaka bo nang le liphetoho tse lekantsoeng k'hemistri ea boko, lebelo la pelo le maemo a lihormone. Taba ea hore ba bang ha ba e bone ha e bolele hore ha e etsahale.

items.myth: Hang ha u e-na le matšoenyeho, u ba le eona bophelo bohle.
items.fact: Batho ba bangata ba fumanang kalafo e nepahetseng bakeng sa matšoenyeho ba bona ntlafatso e kholo mme ba bangata ba fola ka botlalo. Esita le matšoenyeho a tebileng a arabela kalafo le meriana ha e fuoa monyetla.

action_steps.heading: Se o lokelang ho se etsa

items.title: Ithute ho hema bocha
items.description: Ha matšoenyeho a eketseha: phefumoloha bakeng sa lipalo tse 4, tšoara 4, tsoa bakeng sa 6. Ho tsoa ha nako e telele ho khutsisa tsamaiso ea methapo. E sebelise nakong ea ho tšoha - e sebetsa ka mor'a motsotso.

items.title: E bolele ha u e utloa
items.description: Ho re 'hona ke ho tšoenyeha, eseng lefu la pelo' ho thusa ho arola alamo ea 'mele kotsing ea sebele. E fokotsa ho tšoha-ho tšoha.

items.title: Khaola caffeine haeba u khona
items.description: Caffeine ka ho toba e etsisa matšoao a ho tšoenyeha - pelo e mathang, jitteriness. Batho ba bangata ba bona lintlafatso tse kholo libekeng tse 2-3 tsa ho fokotsa kapa ho emisa.

items.title: E-ea tleliniking ho ea hlahlojoa
items.description: Litliliniki tsa mmuso li fana ka tlhahlobo ea mahala ea bophelo ba kelello. Bua le mooki oa bophelo bo botle ba kelello. Thuso le meriana e thehiloeng ho CBT ha ho hlokahala ke mahala.

items.title: Haeba e le litlhaselo tsa ho tšoha ka ho khetheha
items.description: Bala ka taolo ea tlhaselo ea ts'abo - ho tseba mohlala (tlhōrō ka metsotso e 10, ha ho mohla e kotsi, e feta kamehla) ho nka boholo ba tšabo ho bona.

get_help.heading: Ho letsetsa mang
get_help.lede: Ho tšoenyeha ho arabela hantle haholo kalafong. Karolo e thata ka ho fetisisa ke ho finyella khetlo la pele. SADAG le LifeLine li etsa hore ho be bonolo - mahala, lekunutu, ha ho kahlolo.

helplines.name: SADAG Mental Health Line
helplines.description: Keletso ea mahala, ea lekunutu bakeng sa matšoenyeho, tšabo, le khatello ea maikutlo

helplines.name: Fumana tleliniki e haufi le uena
helplines.description: Tlhahlobo le kalafo ea mahala ea bophelo ba kelello ha ho hlokahala
